title: CalibrationEvent
description: A single prediction/outcome pair scored by scripts/knowledge/calibrate-confidence.mjs (WS6). Semantics (binding): scoring is BINARY-ONLY — observedOutcome must be 0 or 1 and originalConfidence is the predicted probability that the predicted outcome occurs; multi-outcome events are rejected by the control with named rule NON_BINARY_OUTCOME. Cross-field rules are enforced by the control script, not this schema: (1) TEMPORAL_INCONSISTENCY when evaluationDate < predictionDate; (2) OUTCOME_LEAKAGE when any outcomeEvidence[].observedAt predates predictionDate; (3) UNRESOLVED_OUTCOME_FIELD when status is 'unresolved' but observedOutcome or non-empty outcomeEvidence is present; (4) AMBIGUOUS_RESOLUTION — resolutionQuality 'ambiguous' or 'contested' events are EXCLUDED from scoring (documented policy: exclude, never down-weight) but reported; (5) unresolved events are excluded from scoring and reported. The control NEVER writes to knowledge/config/governance.json; threshold changes require a reviewed governance amendment.

predictedOutcome.description: Human-readable statement of the predicted binary outcome; originalConfidence is the probability that this outcome occurs.

observedOutcome.description: 1 = predicted outcome occurred, 0 = it did not. Present only on resolved events. The schema permits any non-negative integer so that multi-outcome attempts reach the control, which RESTRICTS scoring to binary and rejects o not in {0,1} with named rule NON_BINARY_OUTCOME; its presence on an unresolved event is rejected with UNRESOLVED_OUTCOME_FIELD.
